measured: At least one checkpoint-leading lineage is also a final drought leader.
limitation: Descriptive toy-model outcomes for these seeds only, not independent evidence about biology.

limitations: A rule-based toy model, not a biological prediction.

Population ties are retained; extinction makes leadership undefined.

One seed is one run; it does not establish a general result.
Food already present at the checkpoint remains in both branches.
